allow: PowerShell(try { $r = Invoke-WebRequest http://localhost:5173 -UseBasicParsing -TimeoutSec 5; Write-Output "FRONTEND $\($r.StatusCode\)" } catch { Write-Output "FRONTEND FAIL: $_" })

PowerShell(try { Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort 8000 -ErrorAction Stop | Select-Object -ExpandProperty OwningProcess | Sort-Object -Unique | ForEach-Object { Stop-Process -Id $_ -Force; "killed pid $_" } } catch { "port 8000 free" }; try { Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort 5173 -ErrorAction Stop | Select-Object -ExpandProperty OwningProcess | Sort-Object -Unique | ForEach-Object { Stop-Process -Id $_ -Force; "killed pid $_" } } catch { "port 5173 free" })
